baseline: previous sweep analysed cccfb328e; its B-1..B-6 were applied in ec4277c0e. git diff ec4277c0e..HEAD -- components lib apps touches only src/lib.rs, src/background.rs and two new repair_test modules (commits 9bd231d85, efd502331); the merge 95cdcb5e5 brought only knowledge/.
method: Both new hunks re-read in full against real dispatch-map / memory-tier / eviction-policy / extent-manager semantics; the 2026-10-20 applied text (B-1..B-6) re-checked clause by clause; all other verdicts re-anchored (lib.rs offsets -3 at 1214, +3 after 1404, +17 after 3545, +40 after 4004; background.rs +5 after 263, +24 after 381) and spot-checked. Adversarial: for each actor that creates, frees or re-creates a key's slot, does flush_to_ssd report exactly the resident entries left without an SSD copy; which callers reach each AlreadyExists exit.
frontmatter_note: spec_sync_* frontmatter left unchanged on purpose (a script re-stamps it); its stamp (cccfb328e) predates 9bd231d85 and efd502331 and the approved working-tree edits.

branch_commits_since_last_sweep.effect: WriteThroughPins records per-key failed write-throughs; flush_to_ssd returns IoError while such a key is resident, else counts resident is_evictable keys (was: queue length before flush)
store_already_resident counted only in reserve_memory, not in evict_and_insert shared with load paths

resolved_since_previous.how: code efd502331 (ALIGN option); close A-07 in align-tasks.md

specs.title: Dispatcher Cache Interface (Memory-Tier Architecture)
aligned: Edge cases: populate-full, evict exhaustion, concurrent lookups, SSD-full write-through, unpersisted skip, SSD-evictor all-pinned, SSD-evictor order, partition guard

drifted.spec_text: flush_to_ssd() -> usize ... returns the number of memory-tier entries that have an SSD copy, or IoError if a write-through to SSD failed for an entry that is still in the memory tier
drifted.actual: returns Result<usize, DispatcherError>; count = resident keys with dm.is_evictable (also requires read_ref==0 && write_ref==0), so pinned persisted entries are not counted

drifted.spec_text: the background writer silently drops the job. The dispatch map entry remains in MemoryTier state. (Known limitation.)
drifted.actual: failure recorded per key (record_write) and reported by flush_to_ssd as IoError while the key is resident

drifted.spec_text: MUST use appropriate read/write locking on the dispatch map
drifted.actual: schedule_write_through job takes no pin (JobStart::Untracked) but settles with convert_to_storage/release_read

drifted.spec_text: Cache removal frees all associated resources (memory-tier slots and SSD extents)
drifted.actual: remove of a persisted MemoryTier entry frees no extent

drifted.spec_text: re-insert the entry into the memory-tier and re-register it as a MemoryTier entry
drifted.actual: no-drives promote_and_serve: create_memory_tier_entry -> AlreadyExists ignored; stray release_write

partially_implemented.requirement: FR-056 flush_to_ssd (same item as D-19, not counted again)
partially_implemented.gap: (a) failed-write record keyed by CacheKey outlives its entry: remove + re-reserve -> flush_to_ssd IoError for an entry never written; (b) landed recorded as written.is_some(), convert_to_storage result discarded

not_verifiable: Edge case: write-ref downgrade lets a concurrent lookup proceed

drifted.spec_text: every key whose copy was in flight is attributed ERROR and none is reported as a hit
drifted.actual: warm batched sync failure only logged; keys stay Ok/Dram

drifted.spec_text: Each attribution value MUST have a test that fails if that value is mis-assigned
drifted.actual: no assertion on ServedBy::{Ssd,Remote,SizeMismatch,Error} in src/

unspecced.feature: per-key failed-write record (record_write / failed_writes) behind flush_to_ssd IoError
